versions.changelog:
- Initial release of mijia-fan skill, version 1.0.0.
- Provides standardized control for Xiaomi 米家风扇: power on/off, speed adjustment, swing control, and device listing.
- Compatible with all AI tools and invocable via trigger phrases (e.g., 风扇, 开风扇, 关风扇).
- Includes command-line script (fan_cli.py) and full setup/usage documentation.
- Uses environment variables to configure target device and parameters.
